description: This file defines a generic decorator class 'CachedCatalogLookupDataServiceDecorator' implementing caching logic for catalog lookup data services. It interacts with local storage to cache data and avoid redundant data retrieval, incorporating logging and expiration logic.

classes.name: CachedCatalogLookupDataServiceDecorator
classes.description: A generic decorator class that adds caching capabilities to catalog lookup data services, using local storage and logging.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of lookup data, returning cached data if valid, otherwise fetching fresh data and updating the cache.
